items.statement: The investigation proposes and records discriminating pathway candidates with candidate-level frequency/connectivity validation and bounded stopping.
items.expected: Each pathway/candidate retains identity, search context, validation outcome, and coverage/termination rationale; minima and transition structures are distinguished by frequencies.

items.statement: A validated profile can test CO capture, iodine transfer, and amine attack using relative Gibbs energies.
items.expected: The report presents state-specific barriers and reaction free energies in kcal/mol with explicit reference states and computational limitations.

items.statement: The four supplied amines must be compared by both activation and tetrahedral-intermediate thermodynamics.
items.expected: Separate entries for aniline, N-ethylaniline, N-methylaniline and morpholine support a conclusion about selectivity without relying on barrier alone.
